text:
maria: Heads up — after the 04:12 runtime push I'm seeing a regression in tool-call / structured-output validation latency in prod. token_validate p95 jumped from ~6ms to ~22ms on /chat-route
perf-bot: deploy/redwood-runtime v3.14.2 -> v3.14.3 by aj at 2026-03-12T04:12:03Z
aj: which metric are you looking at?
maria: Using the token-level histogram we export: redwood_inference_token_validate_duration_seconds_bucket, aggregated by route. Also noticed validate_retry_count increased a bit.
maria: Quick profiler dump shows a lot more kernel selector churn and KV prefetch misses during the high-latency windows.
maria: small flame snippet: 
```
validate_token() {
  if (kernel_change) { kv_prefetch.invalidate(); }
  validate_schema(); // 60% time
  call_tool_validation(); // 30% time
}
```
ryan: can you paste the PromQL you used for the p95?
maria: promql: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_inference_token_validate_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, route))
sam: sounds like the new batching heuristic (latency-aware sampling) is creating smaller micro-batches for certain routes, which increases kernel switches and evicts KV entries more often -> prefetch miss ratio up. we've seen similar in experiments.
aj: do we have a kv_prefetch metric?
maria: yes: redwood_inference_kv_prefetch_hit_ratio (gauge 0..1) and redwood_inference_kernel_selector_changes_total (counter)
ryan: sample queries I'd panel: 
1) Token validate p95 per route: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_inference_token_validate_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, route))
2) KV prefetch hit ratio by route: avg_over_time(redwood_inference_kv_prefetch_hit_ratio{job="inference"}[5m]) by (route)
3) Kernel selector churn: rate(redwood_inference_kernel_selector_changes_total[1m]) by (model_variant, route)
4) Validate retry spikes: increase(rate(redwood_inference_validate_retry_count[5m])) by (route)
ryan: I'll spin up a dashboard draft (per-route rows, token-level histogram panel + small table for kernel changes).
aj: temporary mitigation: revert the latency-aware batching change to conservative round-robin for canary and see if it stabilizes. Also consider tagging validate calls with model_variant+batch_size so panels filter better.
sam: quick experiment suggestion: add a low-cost annotation that forces kernel preference for the long-context path (bind to conservative kernel for seq_len>1024). That should reduce kernel-switch churn and keep KV prefetch warm.
maria: I can roll that as a hotfix if we agree. also we should add an alert: token_validate_p95 > 12ms for 5m for any high-traffic route.
aj: doing a revert on canary now.
dashbot: Revert job started: action/revert-batching-heuristic by aj at 2026-03-12T04:25:10Z
perf-bot: Revert completed on canary, new runtime v3.14.2-c1 at 2026-03-12T04:28:42Z
maria: after revert, p95 back to ~7ms on canary, kv_prefetch_hit_ratio recovered from 0.64 -> 0.95 in ~3 mins
ryan: great, I'll finish the dashboard PR with the queries and add an alert rule + runbook note about kernel-binding as a mitigation.
aj: follow-up items: (1) add per-route batch_size tag to validate metrics, (2) add kernel_selector_changes_total labels for reason, (3) run a short A/B to compare latency-aware vs rr batching with KV-prefetch simulation.
maria: documented the repro and links in the incident doc: https://internal.redwood/inference/incidents/1812345678 (notes + profiler outputs). thanks everyone :tada:
__notes: Slack thread JSON for eng-runtime channel about perf regression: kernel selection, batching heuristics, KV cache behavior, token-level latency metrics, tool-call validation overhead, and dashboard/action items.
